issues.problem: English 'What kind of one do you want?' is unnatural.

issues.jp_before: スマホ{は|wa-topic}画面[がめん]{が/の|ga-sub-clause}大[おお]きい{の|no-pronoun}{を|o-object}選[えら]びました。
issues.problem: English dropped the 'one' that の stands for, so it did not show the drilled function.
issues.action: English changed to 'For my phone, I chose one with a big screen.'

issues.jp_before: 古[ふる]い{の|no-pronoun}{を|o-object}捨[す]てて、新[あたら]しい{の|no-pronoun}{を|o-object}使[つか]ってください。
issues.problem: lv 3 too high; the hardest word, 捨てる, is N4.

issues.jp_before: 娘[むすめ]{の/が|no-subject}かいた絵[え]{を|o-object}、壁[かべ]{に|ni-location}飾[かざ]りました。
issues.problem: English was ambiguous ('drew on the wall'). Also, 壁に飾る marks where something is placed, not where it is, so ni-location is the wrong skill.
issues.action: English changed to 'I hung up on the wall the picture my daughter drew.'; skill changed to ni-destination

issues.jp_before: 妹[いもうと]{の/が|no-subject}飼[か]っている猫[ねこ]{は|wa-topic}、よく窓[まど]{の|no-possessive}外[そと]{を|o-object}見[み]ています。
issues.problem: English 'looks at the view outside the window' is a stilted rendering of 窓の外を見る.
issues.action: English changed to 'often looks out of the window'

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{の/が|no-subject}長[なが]い冬[ふゆ]{は|wa-topic}、早[はや]く寝[ね]ます。
issues.problem: English made the clause restrictive ('in winters when the nights are long'), which implies some winters have short nights.
issues.action: English changed to the non-restrictive 'In winter, when the nights are long, I go to bed early.'
